title: 食い倒れ！ 七福神グルメめぐり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the shopping district to pick up a few things on my day off. Coincidentally…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It's time, Spe! Let's stock up on good luck…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: For the Eat-Till-You-Drop Tour, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Would you like to accompany us? We're on our way to the Eat-Till-You-Drop Seven Gods of Fortune Fine Food Tour! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: With the Seven Gods' blessings, our bellies will be full not just with food, but with good luck too! This event was tailor-made for me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And there's more! I've prepared some special charms, just for today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: They're anti-bloat charms! You can have these two I made as backup!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Looks like I'll be going for seconds on luck as well!
choice_data_list: Seconds on the weight gain too…
Seconds on the weight gain too…
Go and eat until you drop!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yippee! Looks like I'll be going for seconds on luck as well!
choice_data_list: Seconds on the weight gain too…
Seconds on the weight gain too…
Go and eat until you drop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Say what?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Fukukitaru, do you happen to have any charms that'll stop us from gaining weight?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: No, sorry… You see, I gave the one I had to Mc—uh, the daughter of a certain respectable family the other day…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After discussing which charms they'll need the next time around, the pair head home.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: All right! First up is Ebisu's Eb-citing Shrimp Tempura Bowl—ten bowls to be exact!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! And I'll have the Daikokuten's Dai-licious Daikon Hot Pot for ten!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That was delicious! Thanks to the power of the charm, I polished off ten servings lickety-split!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Urk… Yeah, y-you sure did.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'll have the Benzaiten's Un-bean-lievable Red Bean Soup next! I've got a whole nother stomach for sweets, so twenty servings should be a piece of cake! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The great Shiraoki is waiting for me… Waiting to ferry me to the other side…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Eat-Till-You-Drop Tour really lives up to its name… They keep going until they're on the floor…
